title: Path indicator as an affine-subspace indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let a path on $ br^n$ over the binary field assign either no value or a binary value to each coordinate. Its cylinder is the set of binary vectors agreeing with every assigned value; its support consists of the coordinates with assigned values, and its base vector records those values and is $0$ elsewhere. The indicator function of the cylinder equals the indicator function of the translate, by this base vector, of the subspace of vectors that vanish on the support.
hypotheses_covered: A path on the binary cube of dimension $n$
